observations.title: Test harness uses eval to load local module
observations.technical_explanation: Using eval to load a local source file is unnecessary in Node test harnesses; require or vm evaluation would be more conventional and avoid dynamic execution patterns. Because the path is hardcoded and the file is part of the repository, this does not create a runtime risk, but it is a code-quality weakness that can trigger security scanners.
observations.layman_explanation: The tests use a slightly old-fashioned way to load the project's own code. It is not dangerous here because only a fixed project file is loaded, but a more standard loading method would be cleaner.
observations.developer_action: Consider replacing the eval-based module load with require or a vm-based loader to avoid dynamic execution patterns in tests.
